name: Talbutal
aliases: 5-allyl-5-sec-butylbarbituric acid, Lotusate, sec-Butyl allyl barbituric acid, Talbutale, Talbutalum
summary: Talbutal (Lotusate) is a barbiturate with a short to intermediate duration of action. It is a structural isomer of butalbital.S.

pharmacology.text: Talbutal binds at a distinct binding site associated with a Cl− ionophore at the GABAA receptor, increasing the duration of time for which the Cl− ionophore is open. The post-synaptic inhibitory effect of GABA in the thalamus is, therefore, prolonged.

summaryZh: 他布比妥（英語：Talbutal）是一種巴比妥類藥物，作用時間短至中等。它是布他比妥的結構異構體。他布比妥是美國的附表III藥物。

uses.en: It was sold as Lotusate as a sleeping drug and sedative. It is rarely used today.
uses.zh: 它曾以Lotusate為商品名作為安眠藥與鎮靜劑販售，如今已很少使用。
uses.zhHans: 它曾以Lotusate为商品名作为安眠药与镇静剂贩售，如今已很少使用。

sideEffects.en: As a barbiturate, it can cause drowsiness, poor coordination, confusion and dependence. Overdose can stop breathing and is often fatal, and stopping suddenly after regular use can cause dangerous withdrawal with seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 作為巴比妥類藥物，它可能造成嗜睡、協調變差、意識混亂與依賴。過量可能使呼吸停止，往往致命；長期使用後突然停藥可能出現危險的戒斷反應，包括癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 作为巴比妥类药物，它可能造成嗜睡、协调制差、意识混乱与依赖。过量可能使呼吸停止，往往致命；长期使用后突然停药可能出现危险的戒断反应，包括癫痫发作。

fact.en: Talbutal is a structural isomer of butalbital, the barbiturate found in some headache tablets: both are made of exactly the same atoms, just arranged differently.
fact.zh: 他布比妥是布他比妥的結構異構物，後者是某些頭痛藥中所含的巴比妥類藥物：兩者由完全相同的原子組成，只是排列方式不同。
fact.zhHans: 他布比妥是布他比妥的结构异构物，后者是某些头痛药中所含的巴比妥类药物：两者由完全相同的原子组成，只是排列方式不同。
